title: DMA$^2$: Pixel-space Distribution Matching with Adversarial and Anchor Losses
title_zh: DMA$^2$: 像素空间分布匹配与对抗和锚点损失

paragraphs.en: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) provides a general framework for few-step diffusion generation, but its modern text-to-image instantiations have been developed primarily around latent diffusion. It therefore overlooks key properties and design opportunities of native RGB. We revisit two DMD interfaces for pixel-space teachers. On the teacher-matching side, diagnostics show low-noise RGB matching is dominated by a local-texture cue, motivating a fixed high-noise matching band. On the real-data side, native clean-RGB outputs allow guidance from an external visual representation without traversing a decoder or sharing the heavy fake-score critic. DINO-Adv removes this critic from the adversarial gradient path and supplies local parametric patch guidance. For distribution-level guidance, we introduce AF-Loss, a parameter-free auxiliary semantic distribution-field objective designed for text-to-image DMD. It operates on detached rolling real and generated supports in the shared DINOv2 space while preserving prompt-conditioned teacher supervision. AF-Loss adds no learnable parameters or inference-time computation. Together these designs form DMA 2 . Across DPG-Bench, GenEval, VQAScore, and COCO30K, the four-step DMA 2 student performs better than the 25-step teacher and evaluated few-step distillers.

paragraphs.en: Recently, pixel diffusion models ( Yu et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) advance text-to-image generation by modeling images end-to-end in RGB, avoiding the reconstruction ceiling and decoding artifacts of a VAE. However, recent pixel diffusion still requires many sequential denoiser evaluations, making generation slow and costly. Few-step distillation, represented by distribution matching distillation (DMD) ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) , is the standard remedy: it uses a learned fake score to optimize a distribution-matching objective toward teacher outputs, instead of regressing the sampling trajectory step by step, which compounds error as steps are removed ( Luo et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . DMD is general, but its modern text-to-image recipe has been developed primarily around latent diffusion. Direct RGB generation changes both supervision interfaces: fine texture is explicit during teacher matching, while clean outputs expose pretrained visual representations for real-data guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 最近，像素扩散模型（Yu et al., 2026；Ma et al., 2026）通过以 RGB 格式对图像进行端到端建模，推动了文本到图像生成技术的发展，从而避免了 VAE 的重建瓶颈和解码伪影问题。 然而，近期的像素扩散方法仍然需要多次顺序执行降噪器评估，导致生成过程缓慢且成本高昂。 少步蒸馏（以分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）为代表（Yin et al., 2024b；Yin et al., 2024a））是标准的解决方案：它利用一个学习到的虚假分数来优化一个与教师输出匹配的分布目标，而不是逐步回归采样轨迹——后者在减少步骤时会累积误差（Luo et al., 2023；Liu et al., 2024）。 DMD 具有通用性，但其现代文本到图像生成方案主要围绕潜在扩散模型开发而成。 直接生成 RGB 图像改变了两种监督界面：在教师模型匹配过程中，精细纹理是显式的；而干净的输出则暴露了预训练的视觉表示，从而为真实数据引导提供了依据。

paragraphs.en: We analyze how the general DMD recipe interacts with native RGB. For teacher matching, the standard recipe samples matching levels broadly, without accounting for how information is represented in uncompressed RGB. Low-noise inputs already determine coarse image content, so teacher–critic differences can be dominated by fine texture rather than the distributional factors DMD should transfer. Our diagnostics indicate that higher-noise matching is more consistent with structural supervision. For real-data guidance, DMD2 adds a GAN loss against real images ( Yin et al., 2024a ) . Its conventional Feature-GAN design attaches the adversarial head to the 560 560 M fake-score network. For a native-RGB student, this coupling is avoidable: clean outputs allow guidance through a pretrained visual representation without traversing a decoder or sharing the fake-score critic.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析了通用 DMD 配方如何与原生 RGB 相互作用。 在教师匹配方面，标准配方会广泛采样匹配级别，但未考虑信息在未压缩 RGB 中的表示方式。 低噪声输入已经决定了图像的粗略内容，因此教师-批评者之间的差异可能主要由精细纹理主导，而非 DMD 本应转移的分布因素。 我们的诊断结果表明，更高噪声的匹配与结构监督更为一致。 对于真实数据引导，DMD2 增加了一个针对真实图像的 GAN 损失（Yin et al., 2024a）。 其传统的 Feature-GAN 设计将对抗性头附加到 560×560 M 的假分数网络上。 对于使用原生 RGB 的学生模型，这种耦合是可以避免的：干净的输出允许通过预训练的视觉表示进行引导，而无需遍历解码器或共享假分数批评者。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by this evidence, we design DMA 2 , which specializes the teacher-matching and real-data-guidance interfaces of DMD for native-RGB generation. On the teacher-matching side, frequency controls, gradient visualizations, and a targeted matching-band intervention provide converging evidence for a near-clean local-texture bias in native-RGB matching (Section 3.1 ). These diagnostics motivate a fixed high-noise matching band that improves the model’s performance without additional trainable modules or online scheduling. On the real-data side, we exploit direct access to clean RGB through a dual-granularity, critic-decoupled guidance design. DINO-Adv removes the fake-score critic from the adversarial gradient path and uses an 86 86 M-parameter frozen DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) encoder with only 1.58 1.58 M learnable parameters in its heads, reducing same-pipeline step time from 1.82 1.82 to 0.72 0.72 seconds ( 2.5 × 2.5\times faster). This local adversary, however, does not define how each generated sample should move relative to the empirical real and generated distributions in semantic feature space. We therefore introduce Anchor-Field Loss (AF-Loss), a parameter-free auxiliary semantic distribution-field objective designed for text-to-image DMD. AF-Loss acts alongside the prompt-conditioned teacher objective, maintains detached rolling supports across minibatches, and shares the frozen DINOv2 encoder with DINO-Adv. It complements local adversarial guidance without adding learnable parameters or inference-time computation. With both sides addressed, the four-step student performs better than the 25-step DeCo ( Ma et al., 2026 ) teacher and existing few-step distillers on all reported metrics; the same recipe transfers to a second backbone (PixelGen-XXL; Appendix B ). paragraphs.zh: 受此证据启发，我们设计了 DMA 2，它针对 DMD 的教师匹配和真实数据引导接口进行了专门优化，以实现原生 RGB 生成。 在教师匹配方面，频率控制、梯度可视化以及有针对性的匹配带干预，共同提供了趋同的证据，表明原生 RGB 匹配中存在近乎纯净的局部纹理偏差（第 3.1 节）。 这些诊断结果促使我们采用一个固定的高噪声匹配带，该设计无需额外的可训练模块或在线调度即可提升模型性能。 在真实数据方面，我们通过一种双粒度、解耦批评者的引导设计，直接利用纯净的 RGB 数据。 DINO-Adv 将虚假分数批评者从对抗性梯度路径中移除，并使用一个包含 86×86 个参数的冻结 DINOv2（Oquab et al., 2023）编码器，其头部仅含 1.58×1.58 个可学习参数，从而将同一流程步骤的时间从 1.82 秒缩短至 0.72 秒（速度提升 2.5 倍）。 然而，这种局部对抗机制并未定义每个生成样本在语义特征空间中应如何相对于经验真实分布和生成分布进行移动。 因此，我们引入了锚点场损失（AF-Loss），这是一种无需参数的辅助语义分布场目标函数，专为文本到图像 DMD 设计。 AF-Loss 与提示条件化的教师目标函数协同作用，在迷你批量间保持分离的滚动支撑集，并与 DINO-Adv 共享冻结的 DINOv2 编码器。 它在补充局部对抗性引导的同时，未增加任何可学习参数或推理时的计算开销。 在解决了这两个方面后，该四步学生模型在所有报告指标上的表现均优于 25 步的 DeCo（Ma et al., 2026）教师模型及现有的少步蒸馏器；相同的方法也可迁移至第二个骨干网络（PixelGen-XXL；附录 B）。 本工作的主要贡献包括：

paragraphs.en: We specialize both sides of the general DMD recipe for native RGB. paragraphs.en: A line of work generates in RGB without a frozen VAE, from cascaded pixel models ( Saharia et al., 2022 ) to end-to-end RGB transformers competitive with latent models ( Jabri et al., 2023 ; Hoogeboom et al., 2023 ; Hoogeboom et al., 2025 ; Crowson et al., 2024 ) . PixelDiT scales dual-level pixel transformers to megapixel generation ( Yu et al., 2026 ) , whereas PiD uses conditional pixel diffusion for latent decoding and upsampling ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . The paradigm also extends to controllable generation, restoration, depth and geometry, and 3D ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . Our teacher DeCo ( Ma et al., 2026 ) is a frequency-decoupled member of this family. This literature primarily studies the training of native-RGB text-to-image models; few-step distillation tailored to their representation characteristics remains comparatively underexplored.

paragraphs.en: Distribution matching distillation trains a few-step student to match a teacher’s output distribution through a learned fake score ( Yin et al., 2024b ) , and DMD2 adds a real-image GAN term with two-time-scale updates for stability ( Yin et al., 2024a ) . paragraphs.en: We compare the two discriminators head-to-head by porting DMD2’s feature GAN unchanged (a head on block- 7 7 of the 16 16 -block critic, the “Feature GAN” baseline) and swapping only that critic-coupled head for the frozen-DINOv2 adversary, keeping the same DMD and schedule. paragraphs.en: DINO-Adv supplies local parametric patch guidance, but its patch decisions do not specify a distribution-level direction in semantic feature space. A complementary objective for DMD should provide such a direction without replacing the conditional teacher objective, learning another estimator, or modifying inference. We therefore introduce AF-Loss, a parameter-free semantic distribution anchor-field loss for DMD . It turns detached empirical real and generated feature supports into a sample-dependent, multi-scale displacement and injects that displacement as a stopped target for the generator. This is distinct from direct feature regression, whose target does not depend on the geometry of both empirical supports, and from standalone field-based generation ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , where the field itself defines the generative process.

paragraphs.en: We presented DMA 2 , which specializes DMD’s teacher matching and real-data guidance for native-RGB generation. Converging diagnostics identify a near-clean local-texture bias that motivates DM-Band. Native RGB then enables direct external supervision: DINO-Adv decouples local patch guidance from the fake-score critic, while AF-Loss adds parameter-free auxiliary semantic distribution-field guidance, operating on detached rolling supports alongside prompt-conditioned teacher supervision with no learned estimator or inference-time cost. Across four benchmarks, the four-step student exceeds its teacher on all seven metrics and ranks first among the evaluated distillers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 DMA 2，它专门针对 DMD 的教师匹配和真实数据引导，用于生成原生 RGB 图像。 收敛诊断发现了一种近乎纯净的局部纹理偏差，这促使了 DM-Band 的设计。 原生 RGB 图像随后支持直接的外部监督：DINO-Adv 将局部区域引导与虚假分数评判器解耦，而 AF-Loss 则添加了无需参数的辅助语义分布场引导，该引导在脱离的滚动支撑结构上运行，并与提示条件化的教师监督协同工作，且无需学习估计器或推理时的额外开销。 在四个基准测试中，这个四步学生模型在所有七项指标上都优于其教师模型，并在所评估的所有蒸馏器中排名第一。

paragraphs.en: One step denotes a single generator optimizer update, so “20k steps” counts generator updates; the fake-score critic is updated five times per generator step (update ratio 5). Reported seconds-per-step are end-to-end wall-clock over one generator step including its five critic updates and all loss terms, measured on eight A100-80GB GPUs in bf16 autocast mixed precision after 50 warm-up steps, averaged over 200 steps with device synchronization. The 1.58 1.58 M figure is the learnable size of the adversarial heads only: the 560 560 M fake-score critic is trained by every method, so the speedup does not come from fewer trainable parameters but from removing the adversarial gradient path through that heavy critic. paragraphs.en: To test whether the recipe transfers beyond DeCo, we apply the same DMA 2 distillation to a PixelGen-XXL teacher and evaluate few-step students against it. paragraphs.en: To test whether the gain comes simply from applying a frozen-DINOv2 penalty, and whether any distribution-matching objective in the same space would do, we compare AF-Loss against two alternatives on the identical normalized last-layer CLS features, encoder, four-step protocol, and loss weight ( .05 .05 ): (i) direct perceptual matching (regression to real CLS features), and (ii) a matched multi-scale DINOv2-CLS MMD that pulls the generated feature distribution toward the same 256 256 -feature real bank with the same kernel bandwidths, differing from AF-Loss only in that it minimizes a batch-level distribution distance rather than injecting a sample-dependent attract–repel displacement. All rows use the AF-Loss-only ablation setting in Table 2 : DM-Band and DINO-Adv are disabled, and only the feature-space objective is changed. All three add no learnable parameters. Table 6 shows AF-Loss is best on five of the seven metrics; direct regression attains the highest GenEval and MMD the highest recall. Against the stronger MMD baseline it raises DPG by 1.317 1.317 ( 83.194 83.194 vs 81.877 81.877 ), IS by 3.69 3.69 , VQA by 0.0130 0.0130 , and CLIP by 0.0040 0.0040 , approximately matches it on GenEval ( 0.8090 0.8090 vs 0.8077 0.8077 ), and lowers NIQE by 0.859 0.859 ; MMD attains slightly higher recall ( 0.3330 0.3330 vs 0.3161 0.3161 ), indicating marginally broader coverage at the cost of alignment and quality. Direct regression gives higher GenEval but is worse on the other six metrics. The gains therefore do not arise from introducing DINOv2 features, nor from distribution matching per se; they depend on the specific sample-dependent attract–repel field.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试这种提升是否仅仅源于应用了 frozen-DINOv2 惩罚项，以及同一空间中的任何分布匹配目标是否都能产生类似效果，我们在完全相同的归一化最后一层 CLS 特征、编码器、四步协议和损失权重（.05 .05）下，将 AF-Loss 与两种替代方案进行了比较：(i) 直接感知匹配（回归到真实的 CLS 特征），以及 (ii) 一种匹配的跨尺度 DINOv2-CLS MMD，它将生成的特征分布拉向相同的 256×256 特征真实参考集，并使用相同的核带宽；与 AF-Loss 的不同仅在于，它最小化的是批处理级别的分布距离，而不是引入依赖样本的吸引–排斥位移。 所有行均使用表 2 中仅包含 AF-Loss 的消融设置：DM-Band 和 DINO-Adv 已被禁用，仅改变特征空间中的目标函数。 这三种方法均未引入任何可学习的参数。 表 6 显示，AF-Loss 在七项指标中有五项表现最佳；直接回归在 GenEval 上得分最高，而 MMD 的召回率最高。 与更强的 MMD 基线相比，AF-Loss 将 DPG 提升了 1.317（83.194 vs 81.877），IS 提升了 3.69，VQA 提升了 0.0130，CLIP 提升了 0.0040；在 GenEval 上的表现与基线大致相当（0.8090 vs 0.8077）；但 NIQE 降低了 0.859。MMD 的召回率略高（0.3330 vs 0.3161），表明其覆盖范围略微更广，但牺牲了对齐度和质量。 直接回归的 GenEval 更高，但在其他六项指标上表现更差。 因此，这些提升既不是源于引入 DINOv2 特征，也不是源于分布匹配本身；它们依赖于特定的、依赖样本的吸引–排斥场。

paragraphs.en: Two limitations remain. First, DINO-Adv and AF-Loss inherit the inductive biases of the frozen DINOv2 representation. Although its multi-layer patch features and final-layer CLS feature provide complementary local and semantic guidance, they may not fully capture text-conditioned spatial relations or domain-specific visual attributes. Second, our evaluation emphasizes established automated benchmarks and qualitative comparisons; broader human-preference, fairness, and safety evaluations remain future work.
paragraphs.zh: 仍然存在两个局限性。 首先，DINO-Adv 和 AF-Loss 继承了冻结的 DINOv2 表示所具有的归纳偏见。 尽管其多层块特征和最后一层的 CLS 特征提供了互补的局部和语义指导，但它们可能无法完全捕捉到受文本约束的空间关系或领域特定的视觉属性。 其次，我们的评估侧重于成熟的自动化基准和定性比较；更广泛的人类偏好、公平性和安全性评估仍属于未来的工作。
